claim: CAP endorsed at Cg-19 (2023) as recommended practice, in WMO-No.49 Vol I; CAP messages route via WMO Register of Alerting Authorities.
stance_target: Atlas should emit/consume CAP and plan for cell broadcast
quoted_support: the Common Alerting Protocol (CAP) standard was endorsed as a recommended practice for the routine dissemination of alerts and is now included in the Technical Regulations, Volume I (WMO-No. 49).
